
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/shenchuanchao/p/19160108" title="发布于 2025-10-23 11:41">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">ASP.NET Core Blazor 路由配置和导航</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>&nbsp;大家好，我是<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/shenchuanchao">码农刚子</a>。本文系统介绍了Blazor单页应用的路由机制。主要内容包括：1）基础路由配置，通过@page指令定义URL映射；2）路由参数处理，支持参数约束、可选参数和通配符捕获；3）编程式导航实现，利用NavigationManager进行页面跳转和参数传递；4）高级功能如路由事件监听和嵌套路由布局。文章通过代码示例演示了用户管理、产品展示等典型场景的实现方式，完整呈现了Blazor路由从基础配置到复杂应用的全套解决方案。</p>
<div class="lake-content">
<h2 id="rLNDC"><span class="ne-text">1、<span class="ne-text">什么是 Blazor 路由？</span></span></h2>
<p id="uac76b3f6" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">Blazor 路由是一个将 URL 映射到特定组件的系统，允许构建单页应用（SPA）而无需页面刷新。</span></p>
<h3 id="NB40I"><span class="ne-text">核心组件</span></h3>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u81cfbe48" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong><span class="ne-text">Router 组件</span></strong><span class="ne-text">：管理路由匹配和导航</span></li>
<li id="uae35dfd2" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong><span class="ne-text">Route 属性</span></strong><span class="ne-text">：定义组件与URL的映射关系</span></li>
<li id="u939e33a3" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong><span class="ne-text">NavigationManager</span></strong><span class="ne-text">：提供编程式导航能力</span></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="MacB0"><span class="ne-text">2、<span class="ne-text">基础路由配置</span></span></h2>
<h3 id="Amo0I" data-lake-index-type="2"><span>1. <span class="ne-text">应用级路由设置</span></span></h3>
<p id="u34c9271e" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">一般在app.razor文件可以看到路由视图的定义，这个称之为路由模板，当找到相匹配的视图时，会在&lt;Found&gt;&lt;/Found&gt;节点里面渲染出来，如果没有的话会在&lt;NotFound&gt;&lt;/NotFound&gt;节点里面渲染，当然你也可以自定义一个404的页面。里面的DefaultLayout表示默认布局组件，Layout表示指定的布局组件，这些在前面的布局里面讲到过。</span></p>
<p id="uc0d5573f" class="ne-p"><img src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2025/png/61146596/1760596663597-bbf102af-14f0-43ef-8cb8-0badb6b4f321.png" width="891" id="uaeb4acf5" class="ne-image" title=""></p>
<h3 id="X7d7h" data-lake-index-type="2"><span>2. <span class="ne-text">页面路由定义</span></span></h3>
<p id="u74003908" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">在<span class="ne-text">Blazor中使用 @page “url路径” 来表示路由地址，比如/home，那么该页面的请求地址就是域名:端口号/home；</span></span></p>
<p id="u0d0e59a5" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">一个组件也可以设置多个路由访问。</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>&lt;!-- Pages/Index.razor --&gt;
@page "/"
@page "/home"

&lt;h1&gt;欢迎来到首页&lt;/h1&gt;
&lt;p&gt;当前时间: @DateTime.Now&lt;/p&gt;

@code {
    protected override void OnInitialized()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("首页初始化完成");
    }
}</code></pre>
<p id="u939d034a" class="ne-p"><img src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2025/png/61146596/1760596973160-087acedf-f97d-472c-9bbb-1c8d1018c634.png" width="650" id="uea80d4bd" class="ne-image" title=""></p>
<h2 id="Tyscy"><span class="ne-text">3、<span class="ne-text">路由参数</span></span></h2>
<h3 id="YgrYL" data-lake-index-type="2"><span>1. <span class="ne-text">基本路由参数</span></span></h3>
<p id="ubb04b0cb" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">设置路由参数只需要两步就可以设置路由参数</span></p>
<p id="ub7174d1c" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">1，<span class="ne-text">在<span class="ne-text">@page 后面的url中使用{路由参数名}的占位符格式标明</span></span></span></p>
<p id="u0b635bfb" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">2，在@code里面申名一个带有[Parameter]特性的属性，这里是不分大小写的，userName也可以获取到</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>&lt;!-- Pages/UserProfile.razor --&gt;
@page "/user/{UserName}"

&lt;h1&gt;用户资料&lt;/h1&gt;
&lt;p&gt;用户ID: @UserName&lt;/p&gt;

@code {
    [Parameter]
    public string UserName { get; set; }

    protected override void OnParametersSet()
    {
        // 参数变化时执行
        Console.WriteLine($"加载用户 {UserName} 的资料");
    }
}</code></pre>
<div class="ne-quote">
<p id="u61d00653" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">http://localhost:端口/user/码农刚子</span></p>
</div>
<p id="udc421a60" class="ne-p"><img src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2025/png/61146596/1760597994637-9274dc02-d332-4505-b9e4-0c66c71f492a.png" width="255" id="udf297080" class="ne-image" title=""></p>
<h3 id="NMYcE" data-lake-index-type="2"><span>2. <span class="ne-text">路由约束</span></span></h3>
<p id="u427c4a43" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">{路有参数名:参数类型} 表示路由约束，可以限定参数的类型，当参数类型不匹配时,就会跳到错误页面</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>&lt;!-- Pages/Product.razor --&gt;
@page "/product/{Id:int}"

&lt;h1&gt;产品页面&lt;/h1&gt;


@if (Id &gt; 0)
{
    &lt;p&gt;产品ID: @Id&lt;/p&gt;
}

@code {

    [Parameter]
    public int Id { get; set; }
}</code></pre>
<div class="ne-quote">
<p id="uda2732d0" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">http://localhost:端口/product/100</span></p>
</div>
<p id="u19107463" class="ne-p"><img src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2025/png/61146596/1760598239260-ad8d72fd-446c-42cc-a602-8bbc7da67bca.png" width="333" id="u6831c200" class="ne-image" title=""></p>
<div class="ne-quote">
<p id="u2944d1ae" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">http://localhost:端口/product/100b</span></p>
</div>
<p id="ue7bae08a" class="ne-p"><img src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2025/png/61146596/1760598266771-4ef1d8ae-4920-4e7d-9052-5d52ab07daaf.png" width="348" id="uf135a788" class="ne-image" title=""></p>

<h3 id="Algav" data-lake-index-type="2"><span>3. <span class="ne-text">可选参数</span></span></h3>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>&lt;!-- Pages/Product.razor --&gt;
@page "/product/{Id:int}"
@page "/product/{Category}/{Id:int}"

&lt;h1&gt;产品页面&lt;/h1&gt;

@if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(Category))
{
    &lt;p&gt;所有产品&lt;/p&gt;
}
else
{
    &lt;p&gt;分类: @Category&lt;/p&gt;
}

@if (Id &gt; 0)
{
    &lt;p&gt;产品ID: @Id&lt;/p&gt;
}

@code {
    [Parameter]
    public string? Category { get; set; }

    [Parameter]
    public int Id { get; set; }
}</code></pre>
<h3 id="Ww9l9" data-lake-index-type="2"><span>4. <span class="ne-text">捕获所有路由</span></span></h3>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>&lt;!-- Pages/CatchAll.razor --&gt;
@page "/docs/{*path}"

&lt;h1&gt;文档查看器&lt;/h1&gt;
&lt;p&gt;请求的路径: @Path&lt;/p&gt;

@code {
    [Parameter]
    public string? Path { get; set; }
}</code></pre>
<h2 id="NUdYc"><span class="ne-text">4、<span class="ne-text">编程式导航</span></span></h2>
<h3 id="H8smi" data-lake-index-type="2"><span>1. <span class="ne-text">使用 NavigationManager</span></span></h3>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>&lt;!-- Pages/NavigationDemo.razor --&gt;
@page "/navigation"
@inject NavigationManager Navigation

&lt;h1&gt;导航演示&lt;/h1&gt;

&lt;button @onclick="GoToHome" class="btn btn-primary"&gt;返回首页&lt;/button&gt;
&lt;button @onclick="GoToUserProfile" class="btn btn-secondary"&gt;查看用户资料&lt;/button&gt;
&lt;button @onclick="GoBack" class="btn btn-outline"&gt;返回上一页&lt;/button&gt;
&lt;button @onclick="OpenExternal" class="btn btn-info"&gt;打开外部链接&lt;/button&gt;

@code {
    private void GoToHome()
    {
        Navigation.NavigateTo("/");
    }

    private void GoToUserProfile()
    {
        Navigation.NavigateTo("/user/123");
    }

    private void GoBack()
    {
        Navigation.NavigateTo("/previous-page");
    }

    private void OpenExternal()
    {
        Navigation.NavigateTo("https://www.hwtx.top", forceLoad: true);
    }
}</code></pre>
<p id="u019910ed" class="ne-p"><img src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2025/png/61146596/1760599409199-980ee7f9-b16a-4abc-a623-418fe583f21a.png" width="585" id="u92682239" class="ne-image" title=""></p>
<h3 id="vixkN" data-lake-index-type="2"><span>2. <span class="ne-text">带查询参数的导航</span></span></h3>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>&lt;!-- Pages/Search.razor --&gt;
@page "/search"
@inject NavigationManager Navigation

&lt;h1&gt;搜索页面&lt;/h1&gt;

&lt;input @bind="searchTerm" placeholder="输入搜索关键词" /&gt;
&lt;button @onclick="PerformSearch" class="btn btn-primary"&gt;搜索&lt;/button&gt;

@if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(SearchTerm))
{
    &lt;p&gt;搜索关键词: @SearchTerm&lt;/p&gt;
}

@code {
    private string searchTerm = string.Empty;

    [Parameter]
    [SupplyParameterFromQuery(Name = "q")]
    public string? SearchTerm { get; set; }

    protected override void OnParametersSet()
    {
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(SearchTerm))
        {
            searchTerm = SearchTerm;
        }
    }

    private void PerformSearch()
    {
        var query = System.Web.HttpUtility.ParseQueryString(string.Empty);
        query["q"] = searchTerm;
        
        Navigation.NavigateTo($"/search?{query}");
    }
}</code></pre>
<p id="ufb0cc0ed" class="ne-p"><img src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2025/png/61146596/1760599522493-0a4da7e5-8227-4557-b2f3-f18d6302d281.png" width="326" id="u4a53503b" class="ne-image" title=""></p>
<h2 id="OtbqZ"><span class="ne-text">5、<span class="ne-text">高级路由功能</span></span></h2>
<h3 id="MmSbn" data-lake-index-type="2"><span>1. <span class="ne-text">路由事件处理</span></span></h3>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>&lt;!-- Pages/RouteAwareComponent.razor --&gt;
@page "/aware"
@inject NavigationManager Navigation
@implements IDisposable

&lt;h1&gt;路由感知组件&lt;/h1&gt;
&lt;p&gt;位置变化次数: @locationChangeCount&lt;/p&gt;

@code {
    private int locationChangeCount = 0;

    protected override void OnInitialized()
    {
        Navigation.LocationChanged += OnLocationChanged;
    }

    private void OnLocationChanged(object? sender, LocationChangedEventArgs e)
    {
        locationChangeCount++;
        Console.WriteLine($"位置变化: {e.Location}");
        StateHasChanged(); // 通知组件重新渲染
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        Navigation.LocationChanged -= OnLocationChanged;
    }
}</code></pre>
<h2 id="yRMEo"><span class="ne-text">6、<span class="ne-text">布局和嵌套路由</span></span></h2>
<h3 id="prudo" data-lake-index-type="2"><span>1. <span class="ne-text">多布局系统</span></span></h3>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>&lt;!-- Pages/Dashboard.razor --&gt;
@page "/dashboard"
@layout MainLayout

&lt;h1&gt;仪表板&lt;/h1&gt;


@inherits LayoutComponentBase

&lt;div class="admin-layout"&gt;
    &lt;nav class="sidebar"&gt;
        &lt;h3&gt;管理菜单&lt;/h3&gt;
        &lt;NavLink href="/dashboard" Match="NavLinkMatch.All"&gt;仪表板&lt;/NavLink&gt;
        &lt;NavLink href="/users"&gt;用户管理&lt;/NavLink&gt;
        &lt;NavLink href="/settings"&gt;系统设置&lt;/NavLink&gt;
    &lt;/nav&gt;

    &lt;main class="main-content"&gt;
        @Body
    &lt;/main&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;</code></pre>
<h3 id="GjehY" data-lake-index-type="2"><span>2. <span class="ne-text">嵌套路由配置</span></span></h3>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>&lt;!-- Pages/Admin.razor --&gt;
@page "/admin/*"

&lt;h1&gt;管理控制台&lt;/h1&gt;

&lt;nav&gt;
    &lt;NavLink href="/admin/dashboard"&gt;仪表板&lt;/NavLink&gt;
    &lt;NavLink href="/admin/users"&gt;用户&lt;/NavLink&gt;
    &lt;NavLink href="/admin/settings"&gt;设置&lt;/NavLink&gt;
&lt;/nav&gt;

&lt;div class="admin-content"&gt;
    &lt;!-- 嵌套路由内容 --&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;</code></pre>
<h2 id="HlV2X"><span class="ne-text">7、<span class="ne-text">完整示例应用</span></span></h2>
<h3 id="OyuYm" data-lake-index-type="2"><span>1. <span class="ne-text">主布局和导航</span></span></h3>
<p id="u1cd97edf" class="ne-p"><img src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2025/png/61146596/1760602182142-afac8e3f-1c78-4e16-bd04-e26a01e3daf8.png" width="881" id="u13d3f3cc" class="ne-image" title=""></p>
<h3 id="jLWdc" data-lake-index-type="2"><span>2. <span class="ne-text">导航菜单</span></span></h3>
<p id="u23040cbd" class="ne-p"><img src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2025/png/61146596/1760602241273-99d4bccc-9aa2-48f6-aafd-dd76e6d2fc66.png" width="968" id="u28b7c44d" class="ne-image" title=""></p>
<h3 id="HX4RH" data-lake-index-type="2"><span>3. <span class="ne-text">用户管理页面</span></span></h3>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>&lt;!-- Pages/UserManagement.razor --&gt;
@page "/users"
@page "/users/{Action:string}/{Id:int}"

&lt;h1&gt;用户管理&lt;/h1&gt;

@if (Action == "edit" &amp;&amp; Id &gt; 0)
{
    &lt;UserEditor UserId="@Id" /&gt;
}
else if (Action == "create")
{
    &lt;UserCreator /&gt;
}
else
{
    &lt;UserList /&gt;
}

@code {
    [Parameter]
    public string? Action { get; set; }

    [Parameter]
    public int Id { get; set; }
}</code></pre>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>&lt;h3&gt;编辑用户&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;p&gt;用户ID: @UserId&lt;/p&gt;
@code {

	[Parameter]
	public int UserId
	{
		get; set;
	}
}</code></pre>
